info.name: Smart_Agriculture_API
info.description: Phases 1-6: health, auth, profiles, marketplace, orders, verified Daraja STK payments, internal escrow workflow, delivery lifecycle, audited disputes, refund requests, seller payouts and append-only ledger. Development mock providers only simulate outcomes.

request.description: No authentication. HTTP 200 means the API process responds.

response.name: 200 OK
response.body: {"status":"ok","service":"Smart Agriculture Advisory and Market Linkage API"}

request.description: No authentication. Returns 200 when MongoDB responds to ping or 503 when it is unavailable.

exec: pm.test('MongoDB readiness status is explicit', () => pm.expect([200, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Public registration. Rerunning returns 409 for an already registered email or phone.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const u=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(u.role).to.eql('FARMER'); pm.expect(u).not.to.have.property('password_hash'); pm.environment.set('farmer_id', u.id); }
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const u=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(u.role).to.eql('BUYER'); pm.environment.set('buyer_id', u.id); }

request.description: One-time setup. Set admin_bootstrap_token in the selected Postman environment from your private .env. Never publish that value.

exec: pm.test('Created once or correctly reports existing admin', () => pm.expect([201,409]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: Cancel unpaid order and release stock

request.description: Buyer only. Safe to retry: inventory release is idempotent.
Requires the buyer token and an AWAITING_PAYMENT order. The Idempotency-Key prevents a retry from creating another charge. STK Push acceptance is not payment confirmation.
Use only when PAYMENT_PROVIDER=mock and APP_ENV is development/test. This labels an internal payment simulation; it is not an M-PESA transaction.
Repeat the exact mock callback; it must not duplicate ledger entries.
Run before confirming the successful mock callback, or create a fresh order/payment.
Use a separate unpaid order/payment. This records a mock failure and does not mark its order paid.
